facts.text: Saint Henry was laid out in 1837 by Johann Heinrich Römer, who sold the land to his brother Franz on July 7 of that year.
The village officially incorporated in 1901, marking its transition from a settlement to a formal municipality.
A historic church built in 1897 now sits on the National Register of Historic Places, a testament to the town’s architectural heritage.
Henry High School, the village’s lone public high school, has earned 20 state championships across football, volleyball, and other sports.
The town’s athletic legacy includes former NFL players Jeff Hartings, Jim Lachey, and Bobby Hoying, all hailing from Henry High School.
Saint Henry’s town hall remains a central gathering spot, where residents can visit for applications and community updates.
